platform: Packaged Linux client on Xvfb and Mesa software OpenGL
measurement: Completed rendered frames divided by actual elapsed time, refreshed every 0.5 seconds; simulation delta clamps do not affect the count.
checks: Top-right counter visible in city isometric view
Count changes with rendering workload; observed 3 FPS in software-rendered city and 56 FPS in model editor
limitations: Software GPU measurements are not representative of a physical Windows GPU.
